id-20260928-news-2.title: Cayenne Pepper Prices Surge 27 Percent, Food Prices Rise in 314 Regions Toward the End of Q3 2026

segments.src: Harga sejumlah bahan pangan pokok tercatat mengalami kenaikan di ratusan wilayah Indonesia menjelang akhir kuartal III 2026.
segments.tr: The prices of a number of staple food items were recorded to have increased in hundreds of regions across Indonesia toward the end of the third quarter of 2026.

segments.src: Berdasarkan data pemantauan harga yang dihimpun dari berbagai daerah, cabai rawit merah menjadi komoditas dengan kenaikan paling mencolok, yakni sekitar 27 persen dibandingkan periode sebelumnya, dengan rata-rata harga menembus angka Rp76.216 per kilogram.
segments.tr: Based on price monitoring data collected from various regions, cayenne pepper became the commodity with the most striking increase, namely around 27 percent compared to the previous period, with the average price breaking the Rp76.216 per kilogram mark.

segments.src: ## Cabai Rawit Jadi Pemicu Utama
segments.tr: ## Cayenne Pepper Becomes the Main Trigger

segments.src: Kenaikan harga cabai rawit merah tercatat terjadi hampir merata di berbagai wilayah, dari kota besar hingga kabupaten.
segments.tr: The increase in the price of cayenne pepper was recorded to have occurred almost evenly across various regions, from big cities to regencies.

segments.src: Fluktuasi harga cabai memang bukan hal baru dalam pola pangan nasional, mengingat komoditas ini sangat bergantung pada faktor cuaca, musim tanam, serta distribusi antardaerah.
segments.tr: Price fluctuations for chili are indeed nothing new in the national food pattern, considering this commodity is highly dependent on weather factors, planting seasons, and inter-regional distribution.

segments.src: Sejumlah pedagang di pasar tradisional menyebutkan bahwa pasokan cabai rawit dari sentra produksi cenderung berkurang menjelang pergantian musim, sehingga mendorong harga naik di tingkat konsumen.
segments.tr: A number of traders in traditional markets mentioned that the supply of cayenne pepper from production centers tends to decrease approaching the change of season, thereby pushing prices up at the consumer level.

segments.src: Kondisi ini turut dirasakan di sekitar 314 kabupaten/kota yang tercatat mengalami kenaikan harga pangan pada periode September 2026.
segments.tr: This condition was also felt in around 314 regencies/cities that were recorded to have experienced an increase in food prices in the September 2026 period.

segments.src: ## Komoditas Lain yang Ikut Terpengaruh
segments.tr: ## Other Commodities Also Affected

segments.src: Selain cabai rawit, beberapa komoditas dapur lain seperti bawang merah, telur ayam, dan minyak goreng curah juga dilaporkan mengalami penyesuaian harga di sejumlah daerah, meski dengan besaran kenaikan yang lebih moderat dibandingkan cabai rawit.
segments.tr: Besides cayenne pepper, several other kitchen commodities such as shallots, chicken eggs, and bulk cooking oil were also reported to have experienced price adjustments in a number of regions, although with a more moderate increase compared to cayenne pepper.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga pangan yang bersifat musiman seperti ini umumnya menjadi perhatian pemerintah daerah maupun pusat untuk memastikan ketersediaan stok tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: Seasonal food price increases like this are generally a concern for both local and central governments to ensure that stock availability remains maintained.

segments.src: ## Harga Beras Relatif Stabil
segments.tr: ## Rice Prices Relatively Stable

segments.src: Di tengah kenaikan harga sejumlah komoditas dapur, harga beras justru tercatat relatif bertahan stabil di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: Amidst the rising prices of a number of kitchen commodities, rice prices were actually recorded to remain relatively stable in various regions.

segments.src: Stabilitas harga beras ini dinilai penting mengingat komoditas tersebut merupakan bahan pangan pokok yang paling banyak dikonsumsi masyarakat sehari-hari.
segments.tr: This stability in rice prices is considered important considering that this commodity is the staple food most consumed by the community daily.

segments.src: Ketersediaan stok beras yang memadai di berbagai daerah turut membantu menjaga keseimbangan harga di pasar.
segments.tr: The availability of adequate rice stocks in various regions also helps maintain price balance in the market.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## Impact on the Community

segments.src: Kenaikan harga cabai rawit dan sejumlah komoditas dapur lainnya tentu memberi tekanan tambahan bagi pengeluaran rumah tangga, terutama bagi pelaku usaha kuliner yang menggunakan cabai sebagai bahan baku utama.
segments.tr: The increase in the price of cayenne pepper and a number of other kitchen commodities certainly puts additional pressure on household expenses, especially for culinary business owners who use chili as a main raw material.

segments.src: Beberapa pedagang makanan mengaku mulai menyesuaikan porsi maupun harga jual demi menjaga margin usaha di tengah kenaikan bahan baku.
segments.tr: Some food vendors admitted to starting to adjust portions and selling prices to maintain business margins amidst the rise in raw material costs.

segments.src: Bagi konsumen rumah tangga, sejumlah langkah sederhana dapat dilakukan untuk menyiasati kenaikan harga cabai, di antaranya:
segments.tr: For household consumers, a number of simple steps can be taken to get around the increase in chili prices, including:

segments.src: - Membeli kebutuhan cabai secukupnya sesuai konsumsi harian agar tidak mudah membusuk.
segments.tr: - Buying chili needs in moderation according to daily consumption so that it does not spoil easily.

segments.src: - Memanfaatkan cabai kering atau olahan sebagai alternatif saat harga cabai segar sedang tinggi.
segments.tr: - Utilizing dried or processed chili as an alternative when fresh chili prices are high.

segments.src: - Memantau harga di pasar tradisional maupun aplikasi belanja untuk mendapatkan harga yang lebih kompetitif.
segments.tr: - Monitoring prices in traditional markets or shopping applications to get more competitive prices.

segments.src: ## Harapan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Hopes

segments.src: Pemerintah daerah bersama instansi terkait biasanya melakukan operasi pasar dan pemantauan distribusi guna menstabilkan harga pangan, khususnya menjelang periode permintaan tinggi.
segments.tr: Local governments together with related agencies usually carry out market operations and distribution monitoring to stabilize food prices, especially approaching periods of high demand.

segments.src: Masyarakat diimbau untuk tetap bijak dalam berbelanja serta memantau informasi resmi dari instansi setempat mengenai perkembangan harga pangan di wilayah masing-masing.
segments.tr: The public is urged to remain wise in shopping and to monitor official information from local agencies regarding food price developments in their respective regions.

segments.src: Fluktuasi harga pangan seperti ini diperkirakan bersifat sementara dan dapat kembali stabil seiring membaiknya pasokan dari sentra produksi.
segments.tr: Food price fluctuations like this are estimated to be temporary and can return to stability as supply from production centers improves.

segments.src: Masyarakat disarankan untuk selalu memverifikasi informasi harga terkini melalui sumber resmi maupun dinas terkait di daerah masing-masing.
segments.tr: The public is advised to always verify the latest price information through official sources or related agencies in their respective regions.

id-20260928-news-3.title: Trump Rejects Iran's Peace Proposal on Strait of Hormuz, Brent Surges to US$106

segments.src: ## Ketegangan Timur Tengah Kembali Memanas
segments.tr: ## Middle East Tensions Heat Up Again

segments.src: Harga minyak dunia kembali bergejolak setelah Presiden Amerika Serikat Donald Trump dilaporkan menolak tawaran dari pihak Iran yang berisi kesepakatan untuk membuka kembali jalur pelayaran di Selat Hormuz secara penuh.
segments.tr: Global oil prices are volatile again after United States President Donald Trump reportedly rejected an offer from Iran containing a deal to fully reopen shipping lanes in the Strait of Hormuz.

segments.src: Penolakan ini disampaikan di tengah meningkatnya kekhawatiran pelaku pasar global terhadap kelanjutan ketegangan di kawasan Teluk, yang selama ini menjadi salah satu jalur distribusi energi tersibuk di dunia.
segments.tr: This rejection comes amid growing concerns among global market participants regarding the continuation of tensions in the Gulf region, which has long been one of the busiest energy distribution routes in the world.

segments.src: Selat Hormuz dikenal sebagai titik strategis yang dilalui oleh sebagian besar pasokan minyak mentah dan gas alam cair (LNG) dari negara-negara Teluk menuju pasar Asia, Eropa, dan Amerika.
segments.tr: The Strait of Hormuz is known as a strategic chokepoint through which most crude oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) supplies from Gulf countries pass toward Asian, European, and American markets.

segments.src: Setiap gangguan atau ketidakpastian terkait keamanan jalur ini kerap direspons cepat oleh pasar komoditas energi global.
segments.tr: Any disruption or uncertainty regarding the security of this route is often met with a quick response from the global energy commodity market.

segments.src: ## Brent Naik 1,8 Persen, Tembus US$106 per Barel
segments.tr: ## Brent Rises 1.8 Percent, Breaches US$106 per Barrel

segments.src: Merespons perkembangan tersebut, harga minyak mentah acuan Brent tercatat naik 1,8 persen ke level US$106,31 per barel.
segments.tr: Responding to these developments, the benchmark Brent crude oil price was recorded rising 1.8 percent to the level of US$106.31 per barrel.

segments.src: Kenaikan ini mencerminkan kekhawatiran pelaku pasar bahwa jalur distribusi energi di kawasan Teluk berpotensi menghadapi gangguan yang lebih panjang dari perkiraan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: This increase reflects market participants' concerns that energy distribution routes in the Gulf region could potentially face longer disruptions than previously estimated.

segments.src: Sejumlah analis pasar komoditas menilai, sikap Washington yang belum menunjukkan tanda-tanda meredakan ketegangan membuat premi risiko geopolitik pada harga minyak tetap tinggi.
segments.tr: A number of commodity market analysts assess that Washington's stance, which has yet to show signs of easing tensions, keeps the geopolitical risk premium on oil prices high.

segments.src: Pergerakan harga energi dalam beberapa pekan terakhir pun cenderung sangat sensitif terhadap setiap pernyataan resmi dari kedua belah pihak.
segments.tr: Energy price movements in recent weeks have also tended to be highly sensitive to every official statement from both sides.

segments.src: ## Bayangan Ketegangan hingga Pemilu Paruh Waktu AS
segments.tr: ## Shadow of Tension Until US Midterm Elections

segments.src: Yang menjadi perhatian pelaku pasar global saat ini adalah proyeksi bahwa dinamika ini berpotensi berlanjut setidaknya hingga pemilu paruh waktu (midterm election) Amerika Serikat yang akan digelar pada November mendatang.
segments.tr: What is currently concerning global market participants is the projection that this dynamic could potentially continue at least until the United States midterm elections, which will be held this coming November.

segments.src: Faktor politik domestik AS disebut turut memengaruhi arah kebijakan luar negeri terkait kawasan Timur Tengah dalam beberapa bulan ke depan.
segments.tr: US domestic political factors are said to be influencing the direction of foreign policy regarding the Middle East region in the coming months.

segments.src: Ketidakpastian jangka menengah ini membuat banyak lembaga riset energi merevisi proyeksi harga minyak mereka, dengan skenario harga tetap berada di kisaran tinggi selama isu keamanan Selat Hormuz belum menemukan titik terang penyelesaian.
segments.tr: This medium-term uncertainty has led many energy research institutions to revise their oil price projections, with a scenario where prices remain in a high range as long as the Strait of Hormuz security issue does not find a clear resolution.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke Indonesia: Tekanan Biaya Energi Impor
segments.tr: ## Impact on Indonesia: Pressure on Imported Energy Costs

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, yang masih bergantung pada impor sebagian kebutuhan minyak mentah dan produk turunannya, kenaikan harga Brent ini berpotensi menambah tekanan pada biaya impor energi ke depan.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, which still relies on imports for a portion of its crude oil and derivative product needs, this rise in Brent prices has the potential to add pressure to future energy import costs.

segments.src: Kondisi tersebut pada gilirannya dapat berimbas pada beberapa aspek, di antaranya:
segments.tr: This condition, in turn, could impact several aspects, including:

segments.src: - **Beban subsidi dan kompensasi energi** yang harus ditanggung anggaran negara jika harga minyak dunia bertahan tinggi dalam waktu lama.
segments.tr: - **Energy subsidy and compensation burdens** that must be borne by the state budget if world oil prices remain high for a long time.

segments.src: - **Nilai tukar rupiah**, mengingat kebutuhan devisa untuk impor energi yang berpotensi meningkat.
segments.tr: - **The rupiah exchange rate**, considering the potential increase in foreign exchange requirements for energy imports.

segments.src: - **Biaya produksi di sektor industri**, khususnya yang bergantung pada bahan bakar dan energi impor.
segments.tr: - **Production costs in the industrial sector**, especially those dependent on imported fuel and energy.

segments.src: Pemerintah dan otoritas terkait di dalam negeri diperkirakan akan terus memantau perkembangan harga minyak global secara ketat, sembari mengevaluasi opsi kebijakan untuk menjaga stabilitas harga energi domestik di tengah gejolak pasar internasional.
segments.tr: The government and relevant domestic authorities are expected to continue monitoring global oil price developments closely, while evaluating policy options to maintain domestic energy price stability amid international market volatility.

segments.src: ## Pasar Global Wait and See
segments.tr: ## Global Market Wait and See

segments.src: Secara umum, pelaku pasar keuangan global saat ini berada dalam posisi wait and see, menanti perkembangan lebih lanjut dari respons diplomatik antara Amerika Serikat dan Iran.
segments.tr: In general, global financial market participants are currently in a wait-and-see position, awaiting further developments from the diplomatic response between the United States and Iran.

segments.src: Selama belum ada kejelasan mengenai status keamanan Selat Hormuz, volatilitas harga minyak dan aset berisiko lainnya diperkirakan masih akan mewarnai pergerakan pasar dalam beberapa waktu ke depan.
segments.tr: As long as there is no clarity regarding the security status of the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in oil prices and other risky assets is expected to continue coloring market movements for some time to come.

segments.src: Investor domestik maupun internasional disarankan untuk terus mencermati perkembangan berita geopolitik terkini serta indikator makroekonomi terkait, mengingat sensitivitas pasar energi terhadap isu ini masih tergolong tinggi.
segments.tr: Domestic and international investors are advised to continue closely observing the latest geopolitical news developments as well as related macroeconomic indicators, given that the energy market's sensitivity to this issue remains relatively high.

id-20260928-intro-retail-10.title: [Retail #10] Why Are Drink Refrigerators Always on the Very Back Wall?

segments.src: > Tata letak rak, cara barang dipajang, dan arah kaki pelanggan bukan kebetulan — ketiganya adalah alat jualan yang dirancang sejak sebelum toko buka.
segments.tr: > Shelf layout, how goods are displayed, and the direction of customers' feet are no coincidence — all three are sales tools designed even before the store opens.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Bayangkan toko sebagai sebuah kota kecil.
segments.tr: Imagine the store as a small city.

segments.src: Ada jalan raya, ada papan penunjuk arah, ada etalase yang bikin orang berhenti.
segments.tr: There are highways, directional signs, and storefronts that make people stop.

segments.src: Ilmu ritel membagi "kota" ini menjadi tiga lapis yang saling menempel.
segments.tr: Retail science divides this "city" into three overlapping layers.

segments.src: Store layout — jalan raya toko.**
segments.tr: Store layout — the highways of the store.**

segments.src: Layout menentukan ke mana kaki pelanggan bisa dan tidak bisa pergi.
segments.tr: The layout determines where customers' feet can and cannot go.

segments.src: Tiga pola yang paling sering dipakai:
segments.tr: The three most commonly used patterns:

segments.src: - **Grid**: rak lurus sejajar seperti jalan blok perumahan. Dipakai minimarket dan supermarket. Efisien, muat banyak barang, pelanggan cepat menemukan yang dicari. Kekurangannya: terasa "dingin", orang cenderung ambil-bayar-pulang.
segments.tr: - **Grid**: straight parallel shelves like a residential block street. Used by minimarkets and supermarkets. Efficient, holds many items, customers quickly find what they are looking for. Disadvantage: feels "cold", people tend to grab-pay-leave.

segments.src: - **Free-flow**: rak dan meja diletakkan bebas tanpa lorong kaku. Dipakai butik fashion dan toko kosmetik. Mengundang orang berkeliling dan menyentuh barang, tapi boros ruang.
segments.tr: - **Free-flow**: shelves and tables placed freely without rigid aisles. Used by fashion boutiques and cosmetic stores. Invites people to wander around and touch items, but wastes space.

segments.src: - **Loop (racetrack)**: satu jalur utama yang memutar dan akhirnya membawa pelanggan melewati hampir semua kategori. Dipakai department store dan toko furnitur besar.
segments.tr: - **Loop (racetrack)**: a single main pathway that loops and eventually leads customers past almost every category. Used by department stores and large furniture stores.

segments.src: Tidak ada layout "terbaik" — yang ada adalah layout yang cocok dengan misi belanja pelanggan.
segments.tr: There is no "best" layout — there is only a layout that matches the customer's shopping mission.

segments.src: Orang mampir beli pulsa dan air mineral butuh grid.
segments.tr: People stopping by to buy phone credit and mineral water need a grid.

segments.src: Orang yang datang untuk cuci mata butuh free-flow.
segments.tr: People coming to browse need free-flow.

segments.src: VMD (visual merchandising) — bahasa visual toko.**
segments.tr: VMD (visual merchandising) — the visual language of the store.**

segments.src: VMD biasanya dipecah tiga tingkat, dari jauh ke dekat:
segments.tr: VMD is usually broken down into three levels, from far to near:

segments.src: - **VP (Visual Presentation)**: kesan pertama. Etalase depan, manekin di mulut toko, dekorasi tema Lebaran atau tahun ajaran baru. Tugasnya cuma satu: bikin orang berhenti dan masuk.
segments.tr: - **VP (Visual Presentation)**: first impression. Front window displays, mannequins at the store entrance, Eid or back-to-school themed decorations. Its only job: make people stop and enter.

segments.src: - **PP (Point of sale Presentation)**: penunjuk arah di dalam toko. Ujung rak, papan kategori, satu produk yang dipajang menonjol di kepala lorong. Tugasnya: memberi tahu "kategori ini ada di sini".
segments.tr: - **PP (Point of sale Presentation)**: directional signs inside the store. Aisle ends, category boards, a single product prominently displayed at the endcap. Its job: tell them "this category is here".

segments.src: - **IP (Item Presentation)**: penataan barang di raknya sendiri. Urutan ukuran, urutan warna, label harga yang lurus, muka kemasan menghadap depan. Tugasnya: bikin barang mudah dibandingkan dan gampang diambil.
segments.tr: - **IP (Item Presentation)**: arrangement of goods on the shelf itself. Size order, color order, straight price labels, package faces pointing forward. Its job: make goods easy to compare and pick up.

segments.src: Kesalahan paling umum di toko kecil adalah melompat langsung ke IP — rak dipenuhi barang sampai mepet — tanpa VP dan PP.
segments.tr: The most common mistake in small stores is jumping straight to IP — packing shelves until cramped — without VP and PP.

segments.src: Hasilnya toko terlihat penuh tapi tidak ada satu pun titik yang menarik mata.
segments.tr: The result is the store looks full but has not a single point that catches the eye.

segments.src: Satu aturan praktis di level IP: **golden zone**, yaitu rentang ketinggian rak kira-kira 90–150 cm, sekitar mata sampai pinggang orang dewasa.
segments.tr: One rule of thumb at the IP level: **golden zone**, which is the shelf height range of roughly 90–150 cm, about eye to waist level for adults.

segments.src: Barang di zona ini paling mudah dilihat dan diambil, jadi biasanya diisi produk dengan margin bagus atau produk yang sedang didorong.
segments.tr: Items in this zone are easiest to see and grab, so they are usually filled with products with good margins or products being pushed.

segments.src: Barang anak-anak?
segments.tr: Children's items?

segments.src: Justru sengaja ditaruh lebih rendah, setinggi mata anak.
segments.tr: Deliberately placed lower, at a child's eye level.

segments.src: Alur pelanggan (customer flow) — arah kaki, bukan tebakan.**
segments.tr: Customer flow — the direction of feet, not guesses.**

segments.src: Beberapa pola yang dipakai perancang toko:
segments.tr: Several patterns used by store designers:

segments.src: - **Zona dekompresi**: kira-kira 3–5 langkah pertama setelah pintu. Di sini mata pelanggan masih menyesuaikan diri dari terang ke sejuk, dari ramai ke tenang. Promo penting yang ditaruh di zona ini sering tidak terbaca sama sekali.
segments.tr: - **Decompression zone**: roughly the first 3–5 steps after the door. Here, customers' eyes are still adjusting from bright to cool, from busy to calm. Important promos placed in this zone are often not read at all.

segments.src: - **Barang tujuan (destination item) di belakang**: beras, minyak goreng, minuman dingin, susu. Ini barang yang orang rela jalan jauh untuk mengambilnya — maka ditaruh jauh, supaya pelanggan melewati rak-rak lain di jalan.
segments.tr: - **Destination item in the back**: rice, cooking oil, cold drinks, milk. These are items people are willing to walk far to get — so they are placed far back, making customers pass other shelves along the way.

segments.src: - **End gondola**: ujung rak yang menghadap lorong utama. Posisi paling "mahal" di toko karena dilewati hampir semua orang; biasanya diisi promo.
segments.tr: - **End gondola**: the end of the shelf facing the main aisle. The most "expensive" position in the store because almost everyone passes it; usually filled with promos.

segments.src: - **Zona impuls di kasir**: barang murah, kecil, dan tidak butuh pertimbangan — permen, cokelat, baterai, korek.
segments.tr: - **Impulse zone at the cashier**: cheap, small items that require no consideration — candy, chocolate, batteries, lighters.

segments.src: Dan semuanya diukur.
segments.tr: And everything is measured.

segments.src: Dua angka dasar yang dipakai manajer toko:
segments.tr: Two basic numbers used by store managers:

segments.src: Tingkat konversi = jumlah transaksi ÷ jumlah pengunjung
segments.tr: Tingkat konversi = jumlah transaksi ÷ jumlah pengunjung

segments.src: Penjualan per m²  = total penjualan ÷ luas area jual
segments.tr: Penjualan per m²  = total penjualan ÷ luas area jual

segments.src: Kalau pengunjung ramai tapi konversi rendah, masalahnya biasanya bukan promo — melainkan orang tidak menemukan yang dicari, atau antre terlalu lama.
segments.tr: If visitors are busy but conversion is low, the problem is usually not promos — rather, people cannot find what they are looking for, or the queue is too long.

segments.src: Perlu jujur di sini: teknik-teknik ini memang mendorong pembelian tambahan, tapi VMD yang bagus bukan sekadar jebakan.
segments.tr: To be honest here: these techniques do encourage extra purchases, but good VMD is not just a trap.

segments.src: Toko yang rapi, berlabel jelas, dan mudah ditelusuri menghemat waktu pelanggan juga.
segments.tr: A neat, clearly labeled, and easy-to-navigate store saves customers' time too.

segments.src: Yang berlebihan — label harga menyesatkan, jalur keluar yang sengaja dibikin berputar-putar — justru merusak kepercayaan dan menurunkan kunjungan ulang.
segments.tr: Excessive things — misleading price tags, exit paths deliberately made winding — actually damage trust and lower repeat visits.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Coba ingat-ingat terakhir kali kamu mampir ke minimarket 24 jam dekat kos di Jakarta, niatnya cuma beli air mineral Rp4.000.
segments.tr: Try to remember the last time you stopped by the 24-hour minimarket near your boarding house in Jakarta, with the sole intention of buying Rp4,000 mineral water.

segments.src: Pintu kaca terbuka, ada suara "selamat datang".
segments.tr: The glass door opens, there is a "welcome" sound.

segments.src: Tiga langkah pertama relatif lapang — itu zona dekompresi.
segments.tr: The first three steps are relatively open — that's the decompression zone.

segments.src: Kalau di situ ada rak, isinya biasanya barang musiman yang tidak krusial: payung waktu musim hujan, parsel menjelang Lebaran.
segments.tr: If there are shelves there, they usually contain non-crucial seasonal items: umbrellas during the rainy season, hampers ahead of Eid.

segments.src: Kamu belok, dan di kepala lorong pertama ada end gondola dengan mi instan "beli 2 gratis 1".
segments.tr: You turn, and at the head of the first aisle there is an end gondola with "buy 2 get 1 free" instant noodles.

segments.src: Kamu belum butuh, tapi otak sudah mencatat harganya.
segments.tr: You don't need them yet, but your brain has already noted the price.

segments.src: Air mineral?
segments.tr: Mineral water?

segments.src: Ada di kulkas dinding paling belakang.
segments.tr: It's in the refrigerator on the very back wall.

segments.src: Ini disengaja.
segments.tr: This is intentional.

segments.src: Minuman dingin adalah destination item — kamu tetap akan jalan ke sana meskipun letaknya di ujung.
segments.tr: Cold drinks are destination items — you will still walk there even if it's at the end.

segments.src: Dalam perjalanan itu kamu melewati rak snack (setinggi mata, golden zone), rak kopi sachet, dan rak perawatan tubuh.
segments.tr: Along that journey you pass the snack shelves (eye level, golden zone), sachet coffee shelves, and personal care shelves.

segments.src: Di rak snack, perhatikan detail IP-nya: semua kemasan menghadap depan, varian rasa disusun berurutan, label harga sejajar.
segments.tr: On the snack shelf, pay attention to the IP details: all packaging faces forward, flavor variants are arranged sequentially, price labels are aligned.

segments.src: Itu bukan kerapian estetik semata — susunan seperti itu membuat kamu bisa membandingkan tiga merek dalam dua detik, dan barang yang mudah dibandingkan lebih sering dibeli.
segments.tr: That's not purely aesthetic neatness — such an arrangement allows you to compare three brands in two seconds, and easily comparable goods are bought more often.

segments.src: Sampai di kasir, ada keranjang kecil berisi cokelat Rp3.000, permen mint Rp5.000, dan baterai Rp15.000.
segments.tr: Arriving at the cashier, there is a small basket containing Rp3,000 chocolate, Rp5,000 mint candy, and Rp15,000 batteries.

segments.src: Zona impuls.
segments.tr: Impulse zone.

segments.src: Sambil menunggu kasir, tangan bergerak sendiri.
segments.tr: While waiting for the cashier, your hands move on their own.

segments.src: Keluar toko, struk menunjukkan Rp37.000 untuk niat awal Rp4.000.
segments.tr: Leaving the store, the receipt shows Rp37,000 for an initial intention of Rp4,000.

segments.src: Tidak ada yang memaksa.
segments.tr: No one forced you.

segments.src: Yang terjadi adalah kamu berjalan menyusuri rute yang sudah dirancang, melewati barang-barang yang ditempatkan tepat di ketinggian mata, pada urutan yang tepat.
segments.tr: What happened is you walked along a pre-designed route, passing items placed right at eye level, in the exact right order.

segments.src: Hal yang sama berlaku di mal.
segments.tr: The same thing applies in malls.

segments.src: Toko fashion menaruh manekin dengan satu set lengkap di mulut toko (VP) — bukan untuk memamerkan manekin, tapi supaya kamu membeli tiga item sekaligus, bukan satu.
segments.tr: Fashion stores put mannequins with a complete set at the store entrance (VP) — not to show off the mannequins, but so you buy three items at once instead of one.

segments.src: Warung kelontong pun bisa memakai prinsip ini tanpa modal besar: taruh barang laris di ketinggian mata, kosongkan setengah meter pertama dari pintu, dan letakkan gula-kopi-mi di sisi dalam.
segments.tr: Even grocery stalls can use this principle without a large capital: put best-selling goods at eye level, clear the first half-meter from the door, and place sugar-coffee-noodles on the inner side.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. **Layout** adalah jalan raya toko — grid untuk belanja cepat, free-flow untuk cuci mata, loop untuk membawa pelanggan melewati semua kategori.
segments.tr: 1. **Layout** is the highway of the store — grid for quick shopping, free-flow for browsing, loop to lead customers through all categories.

segments.src: 2. **VMD bekerja bertingkat**: VP menarik orang masuk, PP menunjukkan arah kategori, IP membuat barang mudah dibandingkan dan diambil di golden zone (±90–150 cm).
segments.tr: **VMD works in tiers**: VP draws people in, PP shows category directions, IP makes goods easy to compare and grab in the golden zone (±90–150 cm).

segments.src: 3. **Alur pelanggan dirancang, lalu diukur**: barang tujuan di belakang, promo di end gondola, impuls di kasir — dan hasilnya dicek lewat tingkat konversi serta penjualan per m².
segments.tr: 3. **Customer flow is designed, then measured**: destination items in the back, promos on end gondolas, impulse items at the cashier — and results are checked via conversion rates and sales per m².

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Layout yang paling umum dipakai minimarket dan supermarket, dengan rak lurus sejajar seperti blok perumahan, disebut:
segments.tr: **1.** The layout most commonly used by minimarkets and supermarkets, with straight parallel shelves like housing blocks, is called:

segments.src: a) Free-flow layout
segments.tr: a) Free-flow layout

segments.src: b) Grid layout
segments.tr: b) Grid layout

segments.src: c) Loop (racetrack) layout
segments.tr: c) Loop (racetrack) layout

segments.src: d) Boutique layout
segments.tr: d) Boutique layout

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Zona dekompresi — 3–5 langkah pertama setelah pintu masuk — adalah tempat terbaik untuk memajang promo paling penting.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) The decompression zone — the first 3–5 steps after the entrance — is the best place to display your most important promo.

segments.src: **3.** Alasan utama kulkas minuman dingin diletakkan di dinding paling belakang toko adalah:
segments.tr: **3.** The main reason cold drink refrigerators are placed on the very back wall of the store is:

segments.src: a) Supaya kabel listrik lebih pendek
segments.tr: a) To make the power cord shorter

segments.src: b) Karena minuman termasuk destination item, sehingga pelanggan melewati rak lain dalam perjalanan
segments.tr: b) Because drinks are destination items, so customers pass other shelves along the way

segments.src: c) Karena barang berat harus dekat gudang
segments.tr: c) Because heavy goods must be close to the warehouse

segments.src: d) Supaya tidak terlihat dari luar toko
segments.tr: d) So they cannot be seen from outside the store

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Store layout** — pola penataan rak dan lorong yang menentukan ke mana pelanggan bisa bergerak di dalam toko (grid, free-flow, loop).
segments.tr: - **Store layout** — the pattern of shelf and aisle arrangement that determines where customers can move inside the store (grid, free-flow, loop).

segments.src: - **VMD (Visual Merchandising)** — cara menyampaikan pesan toko lewat tampilan, disusun bertingkat dari VP (etalase) → PP (penunjuk kategori) → IP (penataan barang di rak).
segments.tr: - **VMD (Visual Merchandising)** — the way of conveying store messages through displays, arranged in tiers from VP (storefront) → PP (category guides) → IP (shelf item arrangement).

segments.src: - **Planogram** — gambar/panduan rinci yang menentukan produk apa diletakkan di rak mana, baris keberapa, dan berapa lebar mukanya.
segments.tr: - **Planogram** — a detailed drawing/guide that determines what product is placed on which shelf, which row, and how wide its face is.

segments.src: - **Zona dekompresi** — area beberapa langkah pertama setelah pintu masuk, di mana pelanggan masih menyesuaikan diri sehingga sulit menyerap informasi promo.
segments.tr: - **Decompression zone** — the area of the first few steps after the entrance, where customers are still adjusting so it's hard to absorb promo information.

segments.src: - **End gondola (endcap)** — ujung rak yang menghadap lorong utama; posisi paling banyak dilewati mata, biasanya diisi produk promo.
segments.tr: - **End gondola (endcap)** — the end of the shelf facing the main aisle; the position most seen by eyes, usually filled with promotional products.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) b — grid layout, efisien untuk misi belanja cepat dan memuat banyak SKU per meter persegi.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) b — grid layout, efficient for quick shopping missions and holds many SKUs per square meter.

segments.src: 2) X (salah) — di zona dekompresi mata dan perhatian pelanggan belum siap, jadi promo penting di sini cenderung terlewat; letakkan sesudah zona itu, misalnya di end gondola pertama.
segments.tr: 2) F (false) — in the decompression zone, customers' eyes and attention are not ready, so important promos here tend to be missed; place them after that zone, for example on the first end gondola.

segments.src: 3) b — minuman dingin adalah destination item, barang yang tetap dicari meski letaknya jauh, sehingga berfungsi menarik pelanggan menyusuri rak-rak lain.*
segments.tr: 3) b — cold drinks are destination items, goods that are still sought after even if located far away, thus functioning to attract customers to browse other shelves.*

id-20260928-news-1.title: Manufacturing Layoffs Reach 53,490 People Throughout January-August 2026, Signals of Premature Deindustrialization Strengthen

segments.src: ## Angka PHK Manufaktur Terus Merangkak Naik
segments.tr: ## Manufacturing Layoff Figures Continue to Creep Upward

segments.src: Data Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan (Kemnaker) mencatat sebanyak 53.490 pekerja mengalami pemutusan hubungan kerja (PHK) sepanjang Januari hingga Agustus 2026.
segments.tr: Data from the Ministry of Manpower (Kemnaker) recorded that 53,490 workers experienced layoffs (PHK) from January to August 2026.

segments.src: Dari total tersebut, sektor manufaktur tercatat sebagai penyumbang terbesar, jauh melampaui sektor jasa maupun perdagangan.
segments.tr: Of that total, the manufacturing sector was recorded as the largest contributor, far exceeding the service or trade sectors.

segments.src: Kondisi ini menambah daftar panjang kekhawatiran terhadap arah industri nasional.
segments.tr: This condition adds to the long list of concerns regarding the direction of the national industry.

segments.src: Sejumlah ekonom menilai tren ini perlu dicermati serius karena manufaktur selama ini menjadi salah satu penopang utama penyerapan tenaga kerja dan kontribusi terhadap produk domestik bruto (PDB).
segments.tr: A number of economists believe this trend needs to be scrutinized seriously because manufacturing has long been one of the main pillars of labor absorption and contribution to the gross domestic product (GDP).

segments.src: ## Tiga Faktor Utama di Balik Gelombang PHK
segments.tr: ## Three Main Factors Behind the Wave of Layoffs

segments.src: Berdasarkan penelusuran terhadap data dan keterangan pelaku industri, setidaknya ada tiga faktor yang saling terkait dalam mendorong kenaikan angka PHK di sektor manufaktur.
segments.tr: Based on an investigation of data and statements from industry players, there are at least three interrelated factors driving the increase in layoff figures in the manufacturing sector.

segments.src: **Pertama**, pesanan ekspor yang melemah.
segments.tr: **First**, weakening export orders.

segments.src: Perlambatan permintaan dari sejumlah negara mitra dagang membuat pabrik-pabrik berorientasi ekspor, terutama di industri tekstil, alas kaki, dan produk elektronik, mengurangi kapasitas produksi.
segments.tr: The slowdown in demand from a number of trading partner countries has caused export-oriented factories, especially in the textile, footwear, and electronic product industries, to reduce production capacity.

segments.src: **Kedua**, kenaikan biaya produksi.
segments.tr: **Second**, rising production costs.

segments.src: Kenaikan harga energi, bahan baku, serta komponen upah turut menekan margin keuntungan perusahaan manufaktur, khususnya yang berskala kecil dan menengah dengan daya tahan modal terbatas.
segments.tr: Increases in energy prices, raw materials, and wage components are putting pressure on the profit margins of manufacturing companies, especially those on a small and medium scale with limited capital resilience.

segments.src: **Ketiga**, derasnya arus produk impor.
segments.tr: **Third**, the heavy influx of imported products.

segments.src: Membanjirnya barang jadi dari luar negeri dengan harga yang lebih kompetitif membuat produk manufaktur lokal kesulitan bersaing di pasar domestik sendiri, sehingga sejumlah pabrik terpaksa mengurangi jumlah tenaga kerja atau menghentikan sebagian lini produksinya.
segments.tr: The flooding of finished goods from abroad at more competitive prices makes it difficult for local manufacturing products to compete in their own domestic market, forcing a number of factories to reduce their number of workers or stop some of their production lines.

segments.src: ## Kekhawatiran Deindustrialisasi Dini
segments.tr: ## Concerns of Premature Deindustrialization

segments.src: Fenomena menurunnya kontribusi sektor manufaktur sebelum suatu negara mencapai status berpendapatan tinggi kerap disebut sebagai *deindustrialisasi dini* atau *premature deindustrialization*.
segments.tr: The phenomenon of a declining contribution from the manufacturing sector before a country reaches high-income status is often referred to as *premature deindustrialization*.

segments.src: Sejumlah kalangan menilai lonjakan PHK ini bisa menjadi salah satu sinyal awal ke arah tersebut, mengingat pangsa manufaktur terhadap PDB nasional memang menunjukkan kecenderungan menyusut dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.
segments.tr: A number of circles believe that this surge in layoffs could be one of the early signals in that direction, considering that the manufacturing share of national GDP has indeed shown a tendency to shrink in recent years.

segments.src: Namun demikian, sejumlah pengamat juga mengingatkan bahwa data PHK bersifat dinamis dan perlu dibaca secara berimbang.
segments.tr: However, a number of observers also remind us that layoff data is dynamic and needs to be read in a balanced manner.

segments.src: Fluktuasi jumlah PHK pada periode tertentu tidak selalu mencerminkan tren permanen, melainkan bisa dipengaruhi oleh siklus bisnis musiman, penyesuaian pasca-pandemi rantai pasok global, maupun restrukturisasi internal perusahaan.
segments.tr: Fluctuations in the number of layoffs in a given period do not always reflect a permanent trend, but can be influenced by seasonal business cycles, post-pandemic global supply chain adjustments, or internal company restructuring.

segments.src: ## Respons yang Dibutuhkan
segments.tr: ## Needed Responses

segments.src: Para pelaku usaha dan asosiasi industri mendorong agar pemerintah mempercepat sejumlah langkah, di antaranya penguatan insentif bagi industri padat karya, penyederhanaan regulasi perizinan, serta pengawasan lebih ketat terhadap masuknya produk impor agar sesuai standar dan ketentuan yang berlaku.
segments.tr: Business players and industry associations are urging the government to accelerate a number of steps, including strengthening incentives for labor-intensive industries, simplifying licensing regulations, and tighter supervision of the entry of imported products to ensure they comply with applicable standards and provisions.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, penguatan keterampilan tenaga kerja melalui program pelatihan ulang (reskilling) juga dinilai penting agar pekerja yang terdampak PHK dapat lebih cepat terserap kembali ke sektor lain yang sedang tumbuh, termasuk sektor jasa digital dan ekonomi kreatif.
segments.tr: On the other hand, strengthening workforce skills through reskilling programs is also considered important so that workers affected by layoffs can be more quickly absorbed back into other growing sectors, including the digital services and creative economy sectors.

segments.src: ## Menyikapi Data dengan Bijak
segments.tr: ## Responding to Data Wisely

segments.src: Angka 53.490 pekerja yang terkena PHK dalam delapan bulan pertama 2026 memang patut menjadi perhatian bersama, baik pemerintah, pelaku usaha, maupun pekerja itu sendiri.
segments.tr: The figure of 53,490 workers affected by layoffs in the first eight months of 2026 is indeed worthy of collective attention, whether by the government, business players, or the workers themselves.

segments.src: Namun, penting untuk melihat persoalan ini secara utuh dan berbasis data resmi, tanpa terburu-buru menyimpulkan arah kebijakan tertentu semata dari satu indikator.
segments.tr: However, it is important to view this issue as a whole and based on official data, without rushing to conclude a certain policy direction solely from one indicator.

segments.src: Yang jelas, sinergi antara kebijakan industri, perlindungan tenaga kerja, dan daya saing produk dalam negeri akan menjadi kunci untuk memastikan sektor manufaktur Indonesia tetap menjadi tulang punggung perekonomian di tengah tantangan global yang terus berubah.
segments.tr: What is clear is that synergy between industrial policy, labor protection, and the competitiveness of domestic products will be the key to ensuring that Indonesia's manufacturing sector remains the backbone of the economy amidst constantly changing global challenges.
